prompt: The car service process (com.android.car) crashed during boot of our Android Automotive build; logcat.txt has the log. Which source file and line crashed, and which Soong module do I rebuild with m to test a fix? Answer in two lines. Do not change any file and do not run a build.
reference_answer:
packages/services/Car/service/src/com/android/car/power/CarPowerManagementService.java:412 (handleWaitForVhal: mPowerComponentHandler is null).
Rebuild with m CarServiceUpdatable: the file is in filegroup car-service-srcs, which the android_app CarServiceUpdatable uses.
